title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of square tiles seen from above at an angle. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; an orange raised disc labelled Goal marks the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow from the token toward a square one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows apart + columns apart. Every move that goes up or right brings you one step closer; the shortest route is 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up means away from the camera's starting view, toward the goal row. A move off the board does nothing and is not counted.
The start and goal are always the same; Reset returns the token to the same start and clears the move count.
